extension.description: Language support for chronoarchive (.car) files - structured task tracking with syntax highlighting, folding, and diagnostics
semantic.flag: Flags in chronoarchive head lines (e.g., 📝, ✅, TODO)
semantic.datetime: Date and time tokens in head lines
semantic.attributeName: Attribute names in superheaders and item attributes
semantic.attributeValue: Attribute values in superheaders and item attributes
command.addItemAtEnd: Add Item at End of File
config.title: ChronoArchive
config.blankLinesBetweenItems: Number of blank lines to preserve between items. Extra blank lines will be removed.
config.dailyLogsRoot: Root folder for daily log files. File path: <root>/YEAR/YEAR-MONTH/YEAR-MONTH-DAY.car. Empty = platform default: Linux: XDG_DOCUMENTS_DIR or ~/Documents, then 'Daily Logs'; Windows: %%USERPROFILE%%\Documents\Daily Logs
config.dailyLogTemplatePath: Path to a custom template file for new daily logs. Use placeholders {{CREATION}} and {{TIME}}. Leave blank to use the built-in default template.
